description: First full-body identity test: same woman as the canonical portrait (2002, baseline 1001), full-length, neutral activewear, relaxed standing pose. Compares 2002-only vs 2002+1001 references.
settings_note: Nano Banana Pro accepts a seed but does not return one. safety_tolerance left at fal default. Reference order matters: 2002 is always first.
acceptance_rules: Mandatory per image: identity vs 2002 >= 4/5 (judged on manual face crops); photorealism >= 4/5; head-to-shoes, uncropped; natural perspective; face-body cohesion; no exaggerated or artificial proportions.
If the face lacks the resolution to judge identity, mark identity INCONCLUSIVE rather than passing or failing it. Upscaled crops do not recover lost detail.
Head-to-height ratio ~1:7.5 is an approximate reference only, not a mandatory measurement.
Realistic anatomy, natural proportions and 2002 identity outrank the body brief; exaggerated curves fail.
Body brief scored 1-5 per item; target average >= 3.5. Glutes only partly judgeable from the front.
Beauty mark is locked on the subject's LEFT cheekbone; expected to be invisible at full-body distance. No forehead scar (deferred).
Experiment passes if >= 2 of an arm's 4 images meet every mandatory criterion; the arm with more passes decides future reference use.
